Definition: properly, will; concretely, an affair (as a matter of determination)
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉbûw is the word for will, purpose; an affair. It appears once, in Daniel 6:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsᵉbûw because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
